boundary.description: From the junction of Colliers Row Road and Smithills Dean Road, S along Smithills Dean Road and by a beeline W crossing Limefield Road and excluding both sides of Redcar Road, to Dean Brook, SE by the brook to and W along Moss Bank Way (A58), Captain’s Clough Road, W along Church Road, New Church Road, Chorley Old Road (B6226), S by Moss Bank Way to its junction with Old Kiln Lane (B6402), then N along Old Kiln Lane, Walker Fold Road, Colliers Row Road to its junction with Smithills Dean Road.
